{{Quote|Look at me. I was some nobody Republic corporal until the Emperor's voice called me. I was reborn. Guardian Hold Four seemed like such a paltry gift in return.|Daresha|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Daresha''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]] of the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Battle of Corellia|retaking of Corellia]] in the [[Galactic War]]. However, she was actually a [[Children of the Emperor|Child]] of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] and shut down the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] defenses. She was defeated and killed by the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]].
